bulk.title: Bulk actions
bulk.tagsHint: Comma-separated; lower-case letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at most 20 tags per ticket.
bulk.mergeHint: The selected tickets are closed and linked to the target; their conversations stay readable. The target must be a ticket of the same organisation that is neither spam nor merged itself, and not among the selection.
bulk.statusHint: Tickets whose current status does not allow the transition are skipped. Pending pauses the SLA clock; solved and closed stamp the resolution. Spam blocks the sender until the ticket is restored.
bulk.priorityHint: The running SLA clocks move by the difference between the old and the new target, so a shorter target can be overdue at once. Tickets without an SLA policy keep no due times.

summary.unassign: Remove the assignee from the selected tickets.
summary.status: Set the status of the selected tickets to “{status}”.
summary.priority: Set the priority of the selected tickets to “{priority}”.
summary.merge: Merge the selected tickets into ticket #{number} and close them.

viewsPage.intro: Shared views are the team's queues (managed by platform admins); personal views are your own. Every view keeps its filters and sort and shows its live count in the queue.
viewsPage.emptyText: Start from the queue: set the filters you need and choose “Save as view”.
viewsPage.caption: Saved views, shared ones first

viewForm.introNew: Name the view, choose who sees it and set its filters and sort. The values start from the queue you came from.
viewForm.introEdit: Change the name, scope, filters or sort. The view's live count in the queue follows the new filters.
viewForm.name: Name
viewForm.scopeAdminOnly: Shared views are created by platform admins.
viewForm.deleteDescription: The view disappears from the queue for everyone who could use it. Tickets are not affected. This is recorded in the audit log.
viewForm.notEditable: This is a shared view; platform admins edit it. You can open its queue and refine it with the filters.
